lead.headline: Ukraine’s Families Wait as Talks to End the War Begin in Abu Dhabi
lead.deck: Leaders called the first day useful, but both sides still disagree about land.
body: For Ukrainian families, the war Russia began in February 2022 is part of every day. Russian attacks damage the systems that bring power and heat into homes, raising the risk of a hard winter. On Tuesday, teams from Russia, Ukraine and the United States met in Abu Dhabi, in the United Arab Emirates, for two days of talks.

What would make families feel safe after a war? A US official said the talks would focus on security guarantees: promises from other countries to help if Russia attacked again. Ukraine’s lead negotiator, Rustem Umerov, said: “Our people are waiting to end this war.”
Land is the hardest part. Russia holds about 20 percent of Ukraine, and each side wants a different border. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy called the first day “constructive and quite substantive.”

lead.why: Millions in Ukraine live with the war every day, and a safe end depends on promises other countries will keep.

world.headline: Oil Prices Drop Below $90 After Trump Says the Iran War Is “Effectively Over”
world.deck: Iran says no talks are planned, and diesel supplies are still tight.
body: Oil prices reach every kitchen table, through the fuel in cars and buses and the cost of moving goods. On Tuesday, Brent crude, the world’s main oil price, fell to $89.70 a barrel. It was the first time it had been below $90 since August. In late October it was above $117.

The fall came after President Donald Trump said on Monday that Iran, “militarily, is effectively over.” He spoke after meeting the prime minister of Qatar, a key go-between in efforts to end the war. Trump said new strikes were “quite unlikely,” but that US forces were ready if needed.

Iran sees it differently. Its foreign minister, Abbas Araghchi, denied that any meeting was planned. One expert said oil is flowing almost as it did before the war, but diesel supplies are still limited, keeping its price high.

us.headline: Republicans Pick Jim Jordan to Lead Them After Losing the House
us.deck: He won a secret vote against Steve Scalise, 106 to 73.
body: In the US House of Representatives, each party chooses a leader. A week after Republicans lost their majority in the midterm elections, they met on Tuesday and chose Jim Jordan of Ohio in a secret vote. He beat Steve Scalise of Louisiana, 106 to 73.

Jordan, 62, is a close ally of President Donald Trump. He will become the minority leader, the top member of the party with fewer seats. Speaker Mike Johnson said after the election that he would step down from leadership.
Democrats won roughly 260 seats, NBC News reported. Their leader, Hakeem Jeffries, is expected to become Speaker on 3 January.
us.why: The party leaders decide which ideas get a vote, so they shape the laws that reach families. A question for the table: how should a team choose its captain?
also: Senate: Republicans also voted on their leaders on Tuesday; Democrats will choose theirs in early December.
Whip: Tom Emmer will stay as the Republicans’ whip, who counts votes.

india.headline: India Aims to Sell $1 Trillion of Goods and Services Abroad This Year
india.deck: Halfway through, exports have reached about $480 billion, says Piyush Goyal.
body: Exports are the goods and services a country sells to other countries. On Tuesday, India’s Commerce Minister, Piyush Goyal, said India is on track to export $1 trillion of goods and services this financial year. He called the goal “sacrosanct,” meaning it must not be broken.

Halfway through the year, exports have reached about $480 billion, he said. Government figures for April to September show $476.20 billion, up 13.84% from the same months last year. Goyal said the second half of the year normally brings more than the first. Numbers for October come out on 15 November.

Trade deals help. Goyal said India’s goods could enter the 27-nation European Union without import taxes by March or April. India is also in talks with seven or eight more countries. He said European carmakers see India as a place to build cars for India and the world. He spoke at an event for the Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2027, which expects about one million visitors.
india.why: When factories sell more abroad, they may need more workers, and that can reach families’ jobs and earnings.

lines.text: Good morning, and welcome to The Breakfast Table for Wednesday, November 11. Today: peace talks for Ukraine, a big drop in oil prices, and a new leader for one party in the US Congress. Let’s find out what they mean at home.
Let’s start with Ukraine. Where are the talks?

They are in Abu Dhabi, in the United Arab Emirates. On Tuesday, teams from Russia, Ukraine and the United States sat down there for two days of talks. For Ukrainian families, Russian attacks on power and heating make this winter a worry.
What are they trying to agree on?

A big part is security guarantees. Those are promises from other countries to help Ukraine if Russia attacked again. Ukraine’s lead negotiator, Rustem Umerov, said: our people are waiting to end this war.
And what is still hard?
Land. Russia holds about 20 percent of Ukraine, and each side wants a different border. Still, President Zelenskyy called the first day constructive and quite substantive.
So is a deal close?
It is too early to say. These talks are a first step, and there is a second day still to come.
Now, oil. Why did the price fall?

On Monday, President Trump said Iran, militarily, is effectively over, and that new strikes were quite unlikely. On Tuesday, Brent crude, the world’s main oil price, fell to 89 dollars and 70 cents a barrel. In late October it was above 117 dollars.
Does that mean the war with Iran has ended?

Iran sees it differently. Its foreign minister denied that any meeting was planned. One expert said oil is flowing almost as before the war, but diesel supplies are still limited, so its price stays high.
Why does a place so far away change prices here?

The Strait of Hormuz, a narrow sea passage beside Iran, matters for oil, and attacks on tankers there continued this week. Oil prices reach us through the fuel in cars and buses and the cost of moving goods.
Last story. What happened in Congress?

Each party in the House of Representatives picks a leader. A week after losing their majority, Republicans chose Jim Jordan of Ohio in a secret vote. He beat Steve Scalise, 106 to 73. Jordan is 62 and a close ally of President Trump.
So what does his job become?
He will be the minority leader, the top member of the party with fewer seats. Democrats won roughly 260 seats, and their leader, Hakeem Jeffries, is expected to become Speaker on January 3.

Abu Dhabi They met in Abu Dhabi, in the United Arab Emirates.
What did Brent crude fall to on Tuesday?
$89.70 a barrel Brent fell to $89.70, below $90 for the first time since August.
What kind of promise would help a family feel safe after a war ends?
That is all for today. Thanks for listening, and have a lovely day.
